# B2 generated scene prompts · 2026-09-08

Built-in image_gen used. The approved handshake image is reused as `presence.png`; four new photographs use it as the visual reference and `assets/product/vocci-ring-angle.png` as the product reference. These are design-demo lifestyle images, not final product photography. Exact ring geometry remains subject to product review. All linework, 4px focus blur, annotations and software overlays are HTML/CSS/SVG layers.

## capture.png

Use case: photorealistic-natural. ONE wide landscape 16:9 editorial photograph for a full-screen Vocci ring website. Reference 1 is approved art direction: cold-neutral gray/off-white, natural skin, understated fine film grain, minimal airy real-life surroundings, lots of pale negative space. Reference 2 is the EXACT product geometry: wide polished silver titanium band, single large oval physical button and thin circumferential groove. Wear the ring at realistic size on one index finger, exactly one ring in entire image, no other jewelry. Match button shape, material and band geometry closely. Keep hands anatomically plausible, five fingers on each visible hand; no duplicated/merged digits. Compose clear ring-bearing hand around 42-43% x,53% y, with crisp detail on hand, ring, relevant action. Surrounding scene naturally soft but recognizable. We will apply precise blur and fine frames in HTML later: DO NOT bake in borders, text, labels, overlays, grids, UI or watermark. Keep bottom right (x65-95%, y72-95%) almost-white and quiet for a large black headline. Keep full scene continuous, not a collage. No warm beige cast or saturated props. SCENE: A professional woman in a soft slate-blue shirt sits at a pale meeting table, a client's light gray shoulder out of focus at far left. A closed notebook lies on the table. Her ring-wearing left index finger is relaxed and visible at x42%, y53%; her RIGHT hand reaches across and its thumb gently presses the single oval button on the silver ring. Show natural anatomically correct hands and enough upper torso to read as a client conversation. Main person occupies left-middle, clean empty right third for a floating annotation. This is a deliberate button press, not a handshake.
